# @cheesefox/dsh-better-composer
English | 中文
## Summary
DSH Better Composer adds source-preserving Markdown presentation, and fixed local completion candida
tes to a DSH Web Composer. The profile layer contributes Settings and editor presentation through th
e public DSH composer seams. DSH Core remains the owner of source, selection, history, Context Objec
ts, and Send/Queue/Steer. Long pastes can convert into editable reference chips whose LLM-assisted r
ewriting runs as an independent one-shot call outside the session event stream.
## Context Doctor (experimental)
This branch integrates Context Doctor into the **Context Map** workspace. One composer donut opens f
our pages: overview, diagnosis, analysis, and feedback, with independent session and mode scopes. Th
e overview retains the complete native map, including message/step/turn browsing, system and tool so
urces, cache statistics, growth, anchors, compaction, and forks. It defaults to the host's live comp
osition; a separate structural view uses persisted Doctor snapshots and character/4 estimates. Both
views use one interactive donut with a blue/white/gray interface, distinct muted category colors, an
d native DSH theme tokens. Composition totals, window occupancy, and provider-reported usage remain
DSH theme tokens. Composition totals, window occupancy, and provider-reported usage remain distinct.

## Use this package
### Requirements

- A native DSH installation with the `web` profile available.
- DSH `0.1.7-alpha.2` or a newer relea
se that satisfies the peer dependencies in this package. The release tested against the source tree

is `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-alpha.2`.
- Node.js `>=20` and pnpm `>=10`.
- A workspace directory that
DSH can open. File-mode pasted clips need a known workspace path.
Check the native installation before adding the plugin:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Stop the temporary web process after confirming the page opens, then install the plugin into the pro
file you use to run Web DSH.
### Install the published package
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Open the Web URL printed by DSH. Go to **Settings → Built-in plugins → Better Composer** to verify t
he plugin contribution is loaded. Create a new session and confirm the Composer overlay and the `+`
ution is loaded. Create a new session and confirm the Composer overlay and the `+` menu are present.
### Install directly from GitHub source
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The source install is useful for development and always uses the current checkout. It does not modif
y DSH Core; the package is a profile bundle patch plus Host/Client plugin entries.
### Verify the first installation

### What you get
- Markdown visual enhancement for headings, emphasis, links, task lists, quotes, tables, fenced code

, and source-preserving attachment labels.
- Deterministic local completion for approved fence-langu
age, task-marker, and heading-spacing candidates, plus a bounded ghost for approved prompt-section h

eadings.
- Context map (composer donut opens the right sidebar): host-projected occupancy / model wi
ndow, interactive composition donut, structure stats, and per-turn growth. Full history browsing dri
lls down message category → turn → step → source text. Each growth bar opens a turn breakdown with a
nchoring and jump-to-message; system prompts and tool inventory are viewable in full.
- Context management: run `/compact` in-place (with confirmation and a compacting state; compaction
checkpoints are marked on turns); fork a new session after any closed turn; pin turns as anchors sho

wn as blue ticks and diamonds on the growth chart.
- Cache visualization: hit rate, current-context

cache coverage, and read/write tokens (provider prefix caching, automatic).
- Long-paste conversion
into an editable "pasted text" chip (threshold adjustable in Settings; 0 disables): delivery is sele
ctable per chip — inline into the prompt at submit time, or materialized as a workspace file and ref
erenced with the official `@path` file-reference syntax. The workspace file extension is selectable
in the clip editor from a fixed text/code list. Clicking the chip opens a right-sidebar editor suppo
rting manual edits and instruction-driven LLM rewriting with cancellation, preview, apply, undo, red
o, and retry (a one-shot call outside the session event stream, optionally carrying recent session m
essages and the current reasoning effort as reference).
- Four Settings controls: enable Better Composer, Markdown visual enhancement, inactive-line syntax
marker display (hidden or faded), and the long-paste threshold. The per-clip workspace file extensio
n is selected in the clip editor. The legacy `toolbarMode` field remains schema-compatible and is no
t a separate UI toggle.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
The host must provide the declared public composer, Settings, input-trigger, right-Sidebar, and Remo
te seams; an older host missing one disables only that capability. The supported code-language and p
asted-file-extension lists are finite and local. File-mode delivery requires a known session workspa
ce path; clips created before cwd capture fail file-mode sends with an explicit error rather than si
lently. Pure plugin code cannot create Core's opaque attachment receipts, so file-mode clips use the
official workspace `@path` reference convention rather than pretending to be native binary attachme
nts. Paste detection cannot distinguish a paste from any other large single-step insertion (IME comm
its, undo); the threshold limits but does not eliminate false positives. List/quote line-break conti
nuation is supported on Shift+Enter: the keymap arms the continuation at keydown and settles a newli
ne-free follow-up edit (insert the marker, or drop the marker of an emptied item) once Core's native
break lands in the draft, because the public InputActions seam cannot split a paragraph atomically
while preserving the caret. Plain Enter remains Core's submit gesture; a mid-list ordered split renu
